name: Explosive Fervour
description:
Ignore Grenade Skill Cooldowns. 
Grenade Skills fire an additional projectile.
Grenades explode on any impact.
15% increased Attack Speed per different Grenade Skill used Recently.
You cannot gain Explosive Rhythm.
keywordDefinition:
Explosive Fervour is a Buff that grants 15% increased Attack Speed per different Grenade Skill you've used Recently, causes Grenade Skills to ignore their cooldown and fire an additional projectile, and makes Grenades explode on any impact.

You cannot gain Explosive Rhythm while you have Explosive Fervour.
